title: After the Japanese Derby: Live It Up, Even in Defeat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin wins the Japanese Derby. Mejiro Palmer is overwhelmed by her intense dash for the finish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The entire racecourse chants Ines Fujin's name. So moved is she by Ines's performance, Mejiro Palmer finds herself joining in with their cheer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night, after reviewing the day's race, Daitaku Helios seems to have come up with some kind of "god-tier" race plan.
